info.title: Contact information
info.subtitle: The fastest way is a support request from your account: the whole conversation stays there.

cta.textAuthenticated: Describe your question in a request — the answer will arrive in your account and by email.
cta.textGuest: To reply and keep the conversation, we accept requests from your account. You can sign in with your phone number.
